name: Tag - Default (seed v1)
description: A label for item blueprints and categories (e.g. Melee, Legacy v1). Picked on the Tags step of the item blueprint and category forms.

steps.description: Name the label. Most tags only help admins group and find items; the tag "Lootbox Special" also changes how lootboxes treat an item.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Keep names unique. Items tagged "Lootbox Special" are left out of normal lootbox pools and drop only through a lootbox special entry, so don't rename that tag.
